text: The defender moves. The pass arrives. Did that run create the space?
Before the Roar starts with a fictional football film. Watch the play, then watch the AI crew question what it can actually prove.
A new fan gets the concept. A numbers fan gets the limit. Same moment, two useful readings.
The controlled synthetic replay measures players and passes from video. It is a different source from the cinematic film.
Scout spots the shift. Vector measures the passes. Check refuses to call movement proof of cause.
The viewer pushes back: can we credit the runner? The crew has to answer from the record.
Truth Lab changes one defender observation. Thirteen metres becomes zero.
The movement claim falls. The two completed passes still stand.
Four model receipts. Vector is code.
On the phone, the corrected story follows the fan. Same evidence, a simpler explanation.
Captions, voice, color-safe shapes, and a transcript make that story easier to follow.
Publish prepares one checked source for different screens. Preparation and confirmed delivery remain distinct.
Container Apps runs the service. Entra protects access. Foundry reviews. Blob checkpoints preserve corrections. Every stage leaves a trace.
Before the Roar. Every claim earned.
